Advantages

Simplicity, performance and respect for the environment

LOW COST

Made with aluminum tubes and plastic tarpaulins, an economical and accessible solution.

SIMPLE INSTALLATION

Easy transport, assembly without expertise. Adapts to any terrain, land or sea, without work or impact on the environment.

EXPONENTIAL POWER

Energy efficiency squared: efficiency increases exponentially, not proportional to size.

ZERO NUISANCE

Silent operation, minimal visual impact. Respectful of the environment and the neighborhood.

ZERO PLANET IMPACT

No work, no modification of the terrain. Uses only existing natural resources.

LOW TECH SOLUTION

Rustic and lightweight design. Simple, robust and reliable technology for maximum durability.

100% RECYCLABLE

Recyclable aluminum and plastics. Virtuous end of life, easy maintenance, fully sustainable circle.

The Team

A field, industrial and visionary team

Wind to Watt is based on a rare alliance between technological innovation, industrial experience and operational execution. Our strength: transforming a groundbreaking invention into an energy solution deployable on a global scale.

Fabien Brun

Founder & CEO

Fabien Brun, founder and inventor of Wind To Watt, combines scientific expertise and field experience to drive innovation and guarantee efficient wind solutions adapted to real needs.

Reynald Romelard

Production Supervisor — Industrial Partner

Reynald Romelard supervises the production of Wind To Watt systems. With over 35 years of experience in industrial management, he is the manager of the holding company Matériel Santé Environnement (MSE) and partner of Wind To Watt, guaranteeing a solid industrial base and immediate production capacity.
